briefs.prompt: Paint one cream ceramic mug with a round handle on a pale wood table. Soft warm light comes from the left; the wall behind it is muted blue-gray. Leave the background quiet and keep the cup's rim and handle distinct.
Paint a ripe yellow pear with one dark green leaf resting on natural linen. The pear should be the only fruit, centered with a soft shadow and warm side light.
Paint a single scarlet poppy on a slender stem in a small clear vase by a bright window. Preserve the open petals, dark center, and generous cream-colored negative space.
Paint a blue wooden toy sailboat with two cream sails on a pale shelf. The hull should read as wood, with afternoon light and a quiet sea-glass wall behind it.

Paint a small white cottage with a red tiled roof in a meadow. Show the front and one side wall, a short path, two windows, and soft blue morning sky. Keep the architecture legible without drawing every roof tile.

Paint a terracotta pot with one fern on a cream windowsill. Several fronds arch in different directions, and the left window lights the leaves. Make the plant lush while keeping the pot and background simple.
Paint a yellow school bus seen from the front-left three-quarter view on an empty sunlit road. Keep the long side, front windshield, row of windows, and two visible wheels correctly aligned.
Paint a calm black bear standing on pale rocky ground with a blurred green woodland behind it. Keep the head, shoulders, four legs, and ground shadow coherent; simplify tiny fur marks.

Paint a white cup of coffee on a blue saucer, with one silver spoon to its left and one small pastry in the upper-left corner of a warm wooden table. Use the saucer to anchor the cup and keep the latte surface readable.
Paint a white dog standing on grass and holding a large purple frisbee in its mouth. Show all four legs, a readable face, and the disc overlapping the chest without covering the eyes.

Paint two elephants on pale earth: a smaller calf partly behind and reaching over a larger calf in front. Keep their trunks, ears, legs, scale difference, and overlap clear against a soft green background.
Paint a brown dog looking out from the open side of a white pontoon boat on dark water. Keep the broad boat hull, railing, cabin opening, dog face, and reflection in distinct layers.
